summary: CNL Strategic Capital, a non-traded perpetual-life business development company, filed an 8-K reporting routine NAV determinations. The board set August 31, 2026 NAVs per share ranging from $39.32 (Class D) to $45.43 (Class S), aggregate NAV about $1.526 billion across 37,592 shares, and approved adjusted public offering prices effective September 30, 2026, alongside a declared distribution. It also reminded holders of the September 30 quarterly share-repurchase date. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist or strategic-review event is present; this is ordinary BDC valuation, pricing and distribution disclosure, with portfolio fair-value marks driven by fifteen of eighteen holdings.
